notes: log: Go's text logger with Go's exact line format over std::io::Write. Local time is Go's time.Local: TZ and ZONEINFO are read as in Go (rust_stdlib::time::local), and LUTC prints UTC; checked by tools/log_check.py under America/New_York. Deviations forced by Rust std: ...any operands are std::fmt::Arguments; Output's calldepth is ignored (the #[track_caller] chain picks the reported call site); Fatal exits the process and Panic panics with the message String payload as in Go. The earlier JSON-line logger moved to log::json.

Fatal.note: Go's ...any operands are std::fmt::Arguments (format_args!); the text is formatted with Display instead of fmt.Sprint's operand spacing

Llongfile.note: Reports the path rustc was given for the source file, which is relative to the build directory for workspace crates; Go reports the absolute path, and Rust cannot recover the build directory at run time.

Logger.Output.note: Rust cannot walk the call stack, so calldepth is accepted but ignored. The #[track_caller] chain gives the same choice Go's value does: the reported location is the call site of the outermost #[track_caller] function in the chain, so a wrapper marked #[track_caller] reports its own caller (Go's calldepth 2) and an unmarked one reports itself (calldepth 1).
